g.text: PPO lifts our bot from 14% to 32%, beating the bot it copied

text.style: font-size: 15px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #52514e

g.text: Warm-started by imitating our rule-based bot, then PPO against itself and an evolved rival*. 95% intervals; 800 games per point.

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #8a8984

g.text: * Evolved rival: made by evolutionary program synthesis [read: Claude keeps rewriting the bot and we keep whatever wins]. It trades in training; here it plays with trading off, since our bot can't trade.

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #8a8984

g.text: Our bot never proposes laws, talks or trades with players; it votes by the rule-based bot's rule. Wins at the round limit don't count as strength. Sonnet: our bot in every seat in turn; bars are wide.
